name: BestTime.app
description: Global foot-traffic data platform that forecasts hourly busyness for millions of public venues from anonymized GPS data. It has venue search and filters by country/city/neighbourhood, venue type, rating, visit duration and popularity, plus an API for third-party apps (founder-stated). Homepage: "Know When Places Are Busy" and a Venue Filter API for restaurants, shops and attractions (company-stated). Pricing: free test API key; subscriptions $29/mo to $2,999/mo plus usage-based plans (founder-stated). Founded May 2025 (profile), Singapore. Maker "Mick.net", also behind Document.Bot. 142 active subscriptions; L30 profit margin 93%.

mentions.evidence: MRR $9,085 · 142 active subscriptions Last 30 days $12,046 (-14.5%) · last 3 months $40,635 · last 6 months $75,007 Last 12 months $119,728 · all-time $136,510 L30 profit margin 93% (TrustMRR snapshot) For sale: asking $449,000 (3.1x), first listed 18 Feb 2026, 17 offers received. Seller says the sale includes "a high-intent database of 10k+ registered users" (seller-stated). Monthly: $4,447 (Nov 2025) → $9,184 (Feb) → ~$10.8k–11.6k (Mar–Jun) → $12,911 (Jul) → $17,094 (Aug) → $11,335 (Sep); Oct MTD $7,228. Peak was August. Revenue synced 19 October 2026 ~05:29 Warsaw.
mentions.indieAngle: "When is it busy" for one boring venue type where queues cost money: Polish government offices (urząd queues), EV chargers, car washes, ski lifts, border crossings. Wrap the data in a widget the venue can embed, and charge per location.

whyItPrints: Data resale with a clean API, used by city guides, travel apps, retail site analysts and researchers. Developers pay monthly and rarely rip out a working data feed. Revenue roughly tripled in a year.
